title: A synthetic methodology toward π-extended porphyrin-rylenediimide conjugates
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1212-1219
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08045A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Christoph Oleszak, Christian L. Ritterhoff, Erik J. Schulze, Andreas Hirsch, Bernd Meyer, Norbert Jux
A straightforward synthetic route for the preparation of functionalized β-meso-fused porphyrins, which are then connected to rylendiimides is demonstrated. The donor–acceptor-type conjugates show features of panchromaticity and small energy gaps.
